name: planned-modify-licensing-exact-fqn-match
body: Planned-node modifies licensing compares the operation target to the declared planned-node FQNs by exact string equality, not the language-root-tolerant identity used by the coverage check; a plan that declares a planned node bare while a task modifies the rooted FQN (or the reverse) escapes the licensing refusal. Upgrade to a code_identity comparison when plans begin mixing bare and rooted planned-node FQNs.
